owner_report: Bed 4 printed badly on A1; parts left on the plate for photography.
physical_quality: Failed - owner report and substantial visible spaghetti/displaced struts in fresh photos.

visual_review.visible: Large filament nests, fallen/displaced struts and some upright portions.
visual_review.not_observable: Exact first failing layer, initial point of detachment or cause.
visual_review.previous_inspection_limit: Earlier 10:23 images at layer 96 showed upright lower portions only; they did not establish full-height print success.

checks_passed: Correct A1 model and sliced placement from previous package validator
Textured PEI 55 C and nozzle 220 C verified at deposition throughout 291 layers
Continuous 0.2 mm layer progression and deposition in every layer
Actual 8 mm brim toolpaths on all eight objects at 20 mm/s
Part fan commanded full from layer 2 until end; no obvious mid-print fan-off command
Upper-collar overhang walls are slowed to 10 mm/s

printability_risks.risk: Unsupported annular growth on a slender upright shaft can sag/curl or be disturbed by the nozzle despite the slow overhang paths.
printability_risks.causality: Plausible risk, not proof that this caused the observed failure.

printability_risks.risk: Slender parts, long inter-object moves and moving-bed dynamics could contribute to vibration or later detachment; infill commands retain fast vendor defaults.
printability_risks.causality: Not diagnosed from the retained end-state photo or G-code alone.

gcode_review.decision: No clear malformed G-code or thermal/cooling-setting defect found. Proceed with the owner-requested P1S comparison using unchanged geometry/layout and selected process overrides, with its own machine/startup slice.
gcode_review.comparison_limit: P1S has a different loaded PLA spool and different motion/cooling/machine profile; this will not isolate printer hardware alone.
